unit_notes.art-5:18: Six distinct powers/safeguards: second sample on request if possible, temporary removal only if local work impossible, written receipt, qualified return and results on request.
unit_notes.art-5:19: Vehicle and load tasks separated; reasonable cargo judgment; statutory driver documents; stopping/moving ancillary and ministerial stop procedure not independently asserted.
unit_notes.art-5:20: Lawful powers prerequisite, reasonable demand and term; real secrecy exception; responsible authority enforcement; 2026 CBB letters not decisions distinguished from sanction; annex routing limited.
unit_notes.art-5:21: Two-component repair sanction; definition not source of competence; factual execution versus money sanction; no implied destruction.
unit_notes.art-5:22: Repealed slot preserved; no historical wording reconstructed or claimed operative.
unit_notes.art-5:23: Only immediate public order enforcement excluded; not all urgency; no independent power or automatic application of excluded enforcement powers.
unit_notes.art-5:24: Concrete repair, realistic end time, separate recipients; 2025 case short term contextual not fixed general deadline.
unit_notes.art-5:25: Offender, reasonableness, cost notice, post-deadline preparation, late compliance, third-party entry damage and five-year assessment separately; no confusion with debt limitation.
unit_notes.art-5:26: Repealed collection slot not used for current compulsory collection; title 4.4 distinction.
unit_notes.art-5:27: Execution designation versus supervision; separately valid dwelling warrant; neighbor forty-eight-hour notice, urgency exception and damages; current Awbi 2/6 verified.
unit_notes.art-5:28: Sealing ancillary to lawful factual enforcement; scope/proportionality, controlled access and no title transfer.
unit_notes.art-5:29: Removal necessity; report and copy to former manager; safekeeping and return; offender costs versus third-party storage costs.
unit_notes.art-5:30: Thirteen-week route versus disproportionate cost early route; separate two-week minimum starts on report copy; three-year proceeds claim; impossible-sale condition for destruction; 2024 interim proof order not awarded damages.
unit_notes.art-5:31: Prior decision without last versus immediate action without prior decision; differentiated urgency and later disclosure; powers and execution safeguards remain.
unit_notes.art-5:31a: Existing last, qualified applicant, expiry of actual repair period, four-week decision not execution deadline.
unit_notes.art-5:31b: Statutory dependency, partial lapse, distinction suspension and no unverified blanket rule about costs.
unit_notes.art-5:31c: Contest requirement, administrative objection/appeal/higher appeal, judicial referral, copy if possible and provisional relief; 2025 case used as material distinction not procedural ratio.
unit_notes.art-5:31d: Conditional money debt is compliance incentive; no legalisation by payment, no execution authority, forfeiture versus collection.
unit_notes.art-5:32: Derived competence, offender and ability to effect repair, protected interest veto, restricted annex routing and same-offence concurrency.
unit_notes.art-5:32a: Clear measures, actual repair opportunity for specified goals, preventive/recurrence distinction, no automatic suspension by objection or extension request.
